messages.author: 75a41546a8aceaf5
messages.subject: multi select UI / hierarchical UI
parts:
Winston Chang brought up an amazing example of a dynamic UI right here lately. The combination of this example with the on-the-fly .csv download (which could easily be extended to other formats) that was part of the latest shiny release makes me feel like we will need more complex UI widget like multi select or hierarchical representations soon. E.g.: http://quasipartikel.at/multiselect_next/  or the hierarchical  representation Jeroen Ooms used in stock plot . With the speed the R Studio folks bring up new groundbreaking stuff a hardly dare to post a feature request, but hey that's what it is....
This would be incredible useful to ls() a session's memory and then use names to access columns or elements of a nested list. 

Is such an extension of the current UI in the planning?
Can anybody point me to a nice starting point from where I could start try implementing it on my own within the tools shiny uses? Any hints?

Thx in advance

matt

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: multi select UI / hierarchical UI
parts:
If you are handy with HTML/CSS/JavaScript already, I would start by reading the tutorial sections on building inputs and outputs, that will give you an idea of how the pieces need to fit together:

http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#building-inputs
http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#building-outputs

Right now we RStudio folks are focusing on infrastructure of Shiny so it will be a while before we will be looking at adding more widgets (although we have a few in mind already that we'd like to see). But we're hopeful that in the meantime we'll start seeing more and more contributions in this area from the community.
